rows.scope: Bounded independent final review of the current-byte Texas DWI nondisclosure candidate after the completed semantic PASS and central raster PASS. Every original page in the frozen 48-page artifact was reviewed against the exact semantic route, source, component, write, field and custody bindings. No legal re-research, source acquisition, rebuild, reraster or shared-state mutation was performed.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: The exact family, route key, route-selection ID and legal name agree across the current field map, source receipt and settled Texas packet-set record: a Gov't Code § 411.0736 petition for nondisclosure after a DWI conviction without qualifying community supervision. The one route is distinct from the other Texas DWI and nondisclosure tracks; no alternate route is selected or silently substituted.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: All three exact source PDFs are present at their governed wave-one recovery paths and independently match the receipt and admitted source record: petition e8e7dee3c0843a65921ace2545c79034841961d9a131ac31e3d8cf18fd6701db (199202 bytes, 5 pages), proposed order 50e648a3dcaf7db606d23839e2b9ac70b919fe51bab0708a1803e5c37dcd0a5e (108945 bytes, 3 pages), and Statement of Inability bd17a3fe43d6989d1828c91c9a46c873908c272d8e2e342af35ce8bdb2fab10d (6667524 bytes, 12 pages). The receipt records held-byte binding with no fetch or inference. The older custody-reconciliation row's SOURCE_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED value is an acquisition-task history for the former OCA order-label question; it does not contradict the present exact source hash binding.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: The complete five-component set is present in both current fixtures: the five-page official petition, three-page official proposed order, conditional proof-of-delivery page, conditional twelve-page official Statement of Inability, and three-page filing/after-order instructions. The legal packet-set record marks petition, proposed order and instructions required and the proof and fee-waiver components conditional; the receipt identifies the two composed components without inventing an official source form.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: The current canonical and boundary bytes each contain the same fifteen declared identity write occurrences, all read back from flattened widget appearances. The report has thirteen distinct supplied values, no missing occurrence, no refused field with ink and no non-whitespace glyph outside measured write boxes. Only held participant identity facts are written; case facts, route controls, signatures, court-owned fields, prosecutor fields and sworn financial facts remain untouched. The Statement appearances for values 0 and its native 12/15/2022 date are source-authored appearances recorded separately by the byte proof.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: The field map declares 116 required-before-filing entries and the participant blank report emits 116; every one is disclosed in the instructions. The detailed protected blank handoff is 40 entries, and no known required field is missing according to the saved zero-counter report. The disclosures cover court/county/cause and conviction facts, completion and interlock records, split petition address, conditional proof details, sworn Statement facts, signatures and filing steps without inventing unavailable facts.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: No route selection is made. The petition has three participant elections—whether required conviction/sentence evidence is attached, the three-year versus five-year waiting-period limb tied to six months of interlock compliance, and fee payment versus the Rule 145 Statement—and the Statement carries nineteen participant benefit/choice controls. All twenty-two are left for the participant; proposed-order boxes recording court or State action are refused as actor-owned.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: The current census covers all source rows without unmapped, stale-dictionary or caption-drift entries: petition 15 rows over 5 pages, proposed order 14 rows over 3 pages, and Statement 132 rows over 12 pages. The Statement's financial and household rows are classified exhaustively by the field map, and the address is handled by blank shape: whole-line Statement address is written while the petition's split address is disclosed for participant completion. No partial or unbounded row is synthesized.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: The map refuses participant signatures and dates until execution, proposed-order judicial/State/clerk fields, conditional proof facts, the petition split address, Statement financial facts and other actor-owned values. Both byte proofs report zero refused fields with ink, zero outside measured write glyphs and no invisible writes. The participant instructions explicitly explain the protected blanks and the source form’s shared date field boundary.

ARTIFACTS.finding: The current candidate bytes match the rendered-artifacts report and the PF22 transfer: canonical 5670c283390b7f3fe5bd5397438e69929958e7285bff0e3817cf8041899f67df (1224478 bytes, 24 pages) and boundary ea63c40573d81fcbb07ea550c904904a92cc727c62e032f030ac36a8fab18515 (1224846 bytes, 24 pages). The transfer receipt records fifteen extracted Git blobs with zero mismatches or missing files, and the reviewer changed no source or packet byte.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Both page manifests preserve all twenty-four pages in the same canonical order: packet pages 1–5 are the petition, 6–8 the proposed order, 9 the conditional proof-of-delivery component, 10–21 the twelve-page Statement of Inability, and 22–24 the filing/after-order instructions. Each official source page is bound to its exact source hash, and no page is dropped or reordered.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All 48 original PNG pages from the completed current-byte RASTER_PASS artifact were hash-verified against the persisted page inventory and directly viewed. No clipping, overlap, missing ink, unreadable text, page-order defect, protected-field ink or boundary overflow was observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The instructions and settled Texas intake direct filing to the clerk of the court that sentenced the participant (or placed the participant on community supervision), in person, electronically or by mail under § 411.0745(a), with the proposed order where that court requires it. The packet does not substitute arrest county or invent a county-specific filing destination.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The packet preserves the settled fee boundary: § 411.0745(b) fixes the type of civil filing fee, not a uniform amount; OCA describes about $280 varying by county; the clerk is the authority for the local figure; and $28 belongs only to the no-petition § 411.072(c) route. The Rule 145 Statement is supplied conditionally for the participant who cannot pay, with no sworn financial fact guessed or prefilled. The local amount and county practice remain participant/clerk inputs rather than invented packet values.

SERVICE.finding: The source/legal treatment is carried through without conflating court notice and participant delivery. Section 411.0745(e) assigns the State notice and hearing opportunity to the court and says the filer should not be charged; OCA instructions also direct proof that the district attorney received a copy. The packet therefore ships a conditional proof-of-delivery component and tells the participant to ask the clerk, while pre-filling neither service fact nor prosecutor identity.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The instructions preserve the eligibility and escalation boundaries for this DWI path: Class B/non-qualifying-supervision scope, sentence completion, the three- versus five-year interlock condition, evidence of entitlement, collision bar, BAC and offense exclusions, family-violence and prior/subsequent-offense screens, prosecutor/hearing issues, and immigration or other legal-review stops. The packet does not promise nondisclosure and directs a stop when the record or local court practice needs legal judgment.
